title: geckolib issue #836: Crash Between Winter Overhaul (Uses GeckoLib) and Hostile Neural Networks

text: [issue by CraftyZombie] ### Bug Description Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge 21.1.217 Mods: Winter Overhaul overrides the Snow Golem model with a new, Geckolib one. Attempting to render the Snow Golem Data model while both mods are installed together crashes the game. Logs/Crash: https://gist.github.com/CraftyZombie/28823e5a5786dfce1bd7401f4406107a ### How to Reproduce? 1. Install mods. 2. Open world. 3. Open HNN tab in Creative mode. 4. Crash. ### Expected Behavior I expected the model to render rather than crashing. ### Notes *I originally reported this to Winter Overhaul's and Hostile Neural Networks' issue trackers. Shadows_of_Fire (HNN dev) pointed me here. > I don't think there's anything I can do about this. The method I'm using to render the entity is pretty stock, and the crash is due to a mismatch in the vertex builder state which isn't even due to the wrappers I have applied for translucency. > > You could try reporting it to GeckoLib, they might have some idea what's going on. _Originally posted by @Shadows-of-Fire in [#106](https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Hostile-Neural-Networks/issues/106#issuecomment-3865548615)_ https://github.com/bonsaistudi0s/Winter-Overhaul/issues/24 https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Hostile-Neural-Networks/issues/106 [comment by Tslat (collaborator)] This is something on Shadows' side. Raised a PR here: https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Hostile-Neural-Networks/pull/118
